content.user_title: Build Azure AI Projects in Java
content.value_statement: Java developers need concise guidance for Azure AI Foundry project resources. This skill explains the Azure AI Projects SDK clients, authentication, indexes, datasets, connections, and evaluations.
actual_capabilities: Shows the Maven dependency for the Azure AI Projects Java SDK.
Explains PROJECT_ENDPOINT configuration for Azure AI Foundry projects.
Lists SDK sub-clients for connections, datasets, deployments, indexes, evaluations, evaluators, and schedules.
Provides examples for listing connections and indexes.
Shows how to create or update an Azure AI Search index reference.
limitations: It is documentation guidance and does not access Azure resources by itself.
The examples use a beta SDK version and may need updates for newer releases.
Users must provide valid Azure permissions, endpoints, and resource names.
It does not replace project-specific testing, monitoring, or security review.

use_cases.title: Add SDK setup to a Java service
use_cases.description: Use the installation and authentication sections to configure a Java application for Azure AI Foundry projects.

use_cases.title: Explore project resources
use_cases.description: Use the client hierarchy and listing examples to inspect connections, deployments, datasets, and indexes.

use_cases.title: Connect search indexes to AI workflows
use_cases.description: Use the index example to reference Azure AI Search resources from an Azure AI Foundry project.

prompt_templates.title: Set up the SDK
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Java project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add Azure AI Projects SDK setup to my Java project. Include the dependency, endpoint configuration, and authentication pattern.

prompt_templates.title: List project resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic resource discovery in an existing project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to show how my Java app can list Azure AI Foundry connections and indexes with the Azure AI Projects SDK.

prompt_templates.title: Create a search index reference
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate integration with Azure AI Search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a Java flow that creates or updates an Azure AI Search index reference in an Azure AI Foundry project.

prompt_templates.title: Review an SDK integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of project code and operational concerns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Azure AI Projects Java integration for authentication, pagination, error handling, and configuration issues.

output_examples.input: Explain how to authenticate an Azure AI Projects Java client.
output: Use AIProjectClientBuilder with the project endpoint from configuration.
Use DefaultAzureCredential so local development and managed identity can share one pattern.
Confirm the identity has permission to access the Azure AI Foundry project.

output_examples.input: Summarize the SDK clients available in this skill.
output: Datasets support uploaded documents and dataset management.
Evaluations and evaluators support model evaluation workflows.

output_examples.input: What should I check before using the index example?
output: Verify the Azure AI Search connection name.
Verify the target search index name.
Handle missing resources and HTTP errors in application code.

best_practices: Use DefaultAzureCredential and avoid hardcoding secrets in source files.
Keep endpoint and resource names in environment-specific configuration.
Handle pagination and Azure SDK exceptions in production workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not treat sample resource names as production configuration.
Do not print credentials or connection secrets while listing resources.
Do not assume beta SDK examples match every installed version.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for using the Azure AI Projects Java SDK.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends DefaultAzureCredential through AIProjectClientBuilder for consistent local and cloud authentication.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it cover Azure AI Search indexes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an example for creating or updating an Azure AI Search index reference.

faq.question: Does it explain evaluation workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It notes evaluations clients and access to OpenAI evaluation APIs through the SDK.

faq.question: What must I configure before using the examples?
faq.answer: You need a project endpoint, valid Azure credentials, and any resource names used by your workflow.
